text:
maria_cs: FYI SolarWind (enterprise pilot) needs a temporary APAC allowlist + mTLS pin + short rate bump for demo traffic tomorrow morning UTC. Customer says burst for 6 hours, then back to baseline. asking for IPs/hostnames they will hit.

diego_ops: Do we have customer CIDRs? also are they on Hosted or Dedicated? If Hosted, we can do header-based allowlist + per-key rate bump; if Dedicated need infra change.

maria_cs: Hosted API. They provided two source CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/25 and 198.51.100.128/26. Need allowlist + temporary qps increase to 300 qps from 50 for 6h window starting 2026-04-05T02:00Z. They also asked to pin mTLS cert to solarwind-prod.svc.redwood (they run a proxy).

anita_se: Noted renewal flag: they asked about SLAs during demo. Sales notified. For safety we should canary the bump in ap-southeast-1 first for 15m. If no error spikes, roll to ap-east-1.

diego_ops: I can do header-based allowlist + rate window toggle. Infra change not required for hosted. Suggest we apply an auto-revoke at +6h. Command I will run: `rwctl allowlist add --cidr 203.0.113.0/25,198.51.100.128/26 --label solarwind-demo --expires 6h --regions ap-southeast-1,ap-east-1`

kai_support: mTLS pinning: we don't terminate client certs for hosted; they mean pinning to our outbound TLS SNI? Clarify: do they want Redwood to verify client certs (mutual TLS)? Hosted doesn't offer customer-managed client certs for now.

maria_cs: They can present certs via proxy. They asked for our verification of the proxy cert CN=solarwind-prod.svc.redwood. If we can't do mTLS, they asked for hostname allowlist + DNS pinned to those CIDRs.

anita_se: Ok escalate: if customer insists on mTLS, we need an engineering exception for hosted. I've flagged as renewal risk -> Sales follow-up required. For now proceed with IP allowlist + rate bump + auto-revoke.

diego_ops: Scheduled maintenance window created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8271. I'll apply allowlist and bump at 2026-04-05T02:00Z with canary to ap-southeast-1 at 02:00Z then full to ap-east-1 at 02:15Z if metrics look good. I'll set CloudWatch alerts and a rollback trigger on error-rate > 1% or latency P95 > 600ms.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled by diego_ops for CS-8271 — canary in ap-southeast-1 at 2026-04-05T02:00Z.

kai_support: Action item: @maria_cs confirm they accept no mTLS verification for hosted and confirm contact phone for demo. Also collect post-demo logs for quality/regression capture.

maria_cs: Confirmed with customer: they accept hostname allowlist only and will provide contact + test tokens. Phone: +65-9123-4567. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

anita_se: I'll add a note to renewal tracker and attach the demo results. Also requested customer feedback form to capture latency/quality impressions after demo.

diego_ops: Done. Will post thread update after canary at ~02:20Z.

maria_cs: Thanks — please auto-revoke after 6h and DM me when complete.

infra-bot: allowlist added (label=solarwind-demo) for CIDRs [203.0.113.0/25,198.51.100.128/26] in regions [ap-southeast-1,ap-east-1], expires in 6h. Rate limit increased to 300 qps for api-key sk-prod-********, auto-revoke scheduled.
